Name: (AT) Mentyy Chroma Key walls and floors (Greenscreen and bluescreen)
Author: xMentyy
Description:
Mentyy's Chroma Key

I made this alternative textures addon for anyone that wants to transform a room, cabin or shed into a greenscreen/bluescreen(/red/purple...)
I made this mainly with content creators/modders in mind (it is easier to notice subtle texture errors)

I am aware that there is a greenscreen mod already, but I don't like teleporting to the location.


Since this mod adds wallpapers and floors (with AT) you can place whatever furniture you desire in the room.

In case you're not familiar with AT, use the paint bucket tool (available at Robin's) and search for "mentyy" "chroma" or "chromakey" to find the walls/floors.
